title: Minimal and Functional
description: Notetxt is designed with a simple and minimal user interface, while also hiding what you don't need, letting you focus on your thoughts.

title: Markdown Support
description: Edit and preview notes side-by-side with live Markdown rendering! It includes support for most base Markdown syntax and a few Remark/Rehype plugins that add extra features.

title: Manage Multiple Notes
description: Access and manage your notes from the Note Manager! You can do various things to your notes from here, like tagging them, downloading them, renaming them, and more.

title: Note Templates
description: Save time with reusable note templates, like ones for reviews or meeting notes, so that you don't have to start from scratch every time.

title: Simple, Yet Useful Features
description: Notetxt includes a variety of features that can help you improve your workflow while taking notes, such as slash commands, metrics for your notes, exporting of notes, and more!
